headline: Directed delegate to vote on 15 state school association resolutions as recommended, 6-0 with one abstention.
summary: The meeting covered facilities, human resources, technology, busing, special education, curriculum, and test scores. It approved consent agenda items, including a $3,916,296.42 manifest. It chose Karen Rand as voting delegate and Michael Thiele as alternate for the state association's October 17 assembly.
decisions: Approved consent agenda, including minutes and a $3,916,296.42 manifest, $375,527.06 general payroll, and $3,540,769.36 general expense, 7-0.
Named Karen Rand as voting delegate and Michael Thiele as alternate for the NH School Boards Association assembly, and allowed the delegate to vote on amendments without substantive change, 7-0.
Directed the delegate to vote in support of proposed changes to the NH School Boards Association bylaws, 7-0.
Directed the delegate to vote on the 15 proposed resolutions according to the NH School Boards Association Board of Directors' recommendations, 6-0 with one abstention.

decision_evidence.quote: The Board approved the Public Meeting Minutes of September 9, 2026; the Nonpublic Meeting Minutes of September 9, 2026; a Manifest in the amount of $3,916,296.42; $375,527.06 General Payroll; and $3,540,769.36 General Expense. ... Vote: Yes - Unanimous (7/0)

Jenna Paradise Moved to accept a motion to nominate Karen Rand as the Board's voting delegate and Michael Thiele as alternate and to direct the delegate the authority to vote on amendments so long as there is no substantive change to the meaning of the overall resolution. ... Vote: Yes - Unanimous (7/0)

Jennifer Theroux Moved to accept the motion to direct the delegate to vote in support of the proposed changes to the bylaws of the New Hampshire School Board Association. Jamie Carreau seconded the Motion. Vote: Yes - Unanimous (7/0)

Jennifer Theroux Moved to accept the motion to direct the delegate to vote on the 15 proposed resolutions according to the recommendation of the NHSBA Board of Directors. Jenna Paradise seconded the Motion. Vote: Yes - 6/0 1 abstention
